questions.question: Name three persuasive techniques and explain how each works.

points.text: Rhetorical questions (make reader think), emotive language (evoke feelings), statistics (add credibility) - plus many other valid techniques.

questions.question: Why is it important to address counter-arguments in persuasive writing?

points.text: It shows you've considered different viewpoints and strengthens your argument by preemptively refuting opposition.

questions.question: Write an opening paragraph persuading your school to introduce a healthy eating policy.

points.text: Your paragraph should include: clear viewpoint, rhetorical question or hook, and persuasive techniques.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a "call to action" in persuasive writing?

points.text: A call to action tells the reader exactly what you want them to do after reading, making your writing purposeful and memorable.
